description: Two adjacent items named by the fz-go4.18.33 removable-code audit (at b5b341bff), both in transport_contract_test.rs, both out of that ticket's blast radius. (1) seam_executable (~:5205, single caller) matches CodegenSeam — a DIFFERENT enum with no executable() accessor and two None-returning arms (CallableBoundary, FirstClassPublication). Add impl CodegenSeam { fn executable(&self) -> Option<&ExecutableSymbol> } for parity with TransportPosition::executable and route seam_executable through it. (2) transport_position_is_semantic (~:5218, single caller at :2317) exhaustively matches all 7 TransportPosition variants and returns true in every arm — tautological today (audit proved by deletion: suite stayed 963/0/24). It is load-bearing ONLY as a future-variant guard (a new variant would force explicit true/false classification). Decide: delete it, or keep with a comment stating it exists solely to force classification of future variants. Test-only; two-lane audit.
title: CodegenSeam::executable accessor + review the tautological transport_position_is_semantic guard
